'''Wetyin''' was the largest of the four continents located on the jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SoR" /> It was named by [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Lile Gorsek]].

The [[Lost City of the Jedi]] was located beneath the surface of the continent.
